title: Warm Smoky American Portobello Skewers
description: A plant-based friendly American dish featuring herbal and smoky flavors, perfect for a date night, made with ghee and char-grilled to perfection, served with a sweet and tangy glassy-jelly sauce.

ingredients.name: Portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together melted ghee, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced Portobello mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the ghee mixture.
Thread the coated mushroom slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each slice.
Grill the skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until the mushrooms are tender and slightly charred.
While the mushrooms are grilling, combine apple cider vinegar, date syrup, and chopped thyme in a small saucepan.
Bring the saucepan mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened into a glassy-jelly consistency.
Remove the skewers from the grill and brush with the glassy-jelly sauce.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional chopped thyme if desired.
